title: ocean-love.xyz execution strategy
source_notes: venture_lock = questionnaire. roadmap.json = actionable queue (capacity + revenue tracks + ruthless tasks). Sister patterns: ../star_rise_sc/roadmap.json. Sister crown research: ../regenerative_habitat
owns: Everything for people who love the ocean.

venture_lock.north_star: People never have to look elsewhere to maximize ocean enjoyment — conservation, eco tourism & gear, or regenerative living — without greenwash or extractive markup.
values: Prosperity / fair trade for creators & locals
venture_lock.pride_peak: Regenerative coastal deal closes; funding distributed to builders/designers; ecology + human/ocean coexistence is real and tracked.
venture_lock.genie_24mo: In / closing regenerative coastal deals (wealth + distribution to builders)
venture_lock.next_90_days_energy: Talking to builders / funders / regenerative designers (≤2 hrs/week, light + fun)
later_not_now: Ocean Ways dock-to-table adventures (amenity after capital)
Ocean cleaning tech engineering shop (after RE pickup)
venture_lock.software_rule: Build product software only when aiming at real mass enjoyment (~1M mindset) — no more directionless prototypes.

repo_split.regenerative_habitat: Base regenerative research index — global/inland/coastal manuscripts, catalog generator, studies. Expand here.
repo_split.ocean-love-xyz: Ocean love face + published near-ocean Habitat slice (swim-friendly places, coastal guides). Not the full regenerative encyclopedia.
repo_split.jammin: Side empire — fair event ticketing → decentralized loyalty (attendance ↔ products ↔ perks) that can eventually feed ocean experiences, regenerative resident life, and other loves. Soccer/amateur is the wedge market, not the pride peak.
repo_split.hyperscale-rs: Sister craft — multi-shard docs + protocol contribution; lives in its own hours, not this ocean block’s queue
repo_split.star_rise_sc: Sister ops pattern source — capacity, ruthless tasks, revenue tracks (not this ocean queue)

content_boundary.ocean_love_habitat: near-ocean only (catalog swim≥3; coastal guides Yucatán / Indonesia / Malaysia)
content_boundary.regenerative_habitat: full regenerative living lab — can grow global later; sister stays source of truth for research depth

empire_map.crown: Regenerative coastal deals (RH) — focus of this ≤2 hr/week roadmap
empire_map.side_empire: JAMMIN — loyalty + fair events rails (own repo/hours)
empire_map.feed_forward: JAMMIN loyalty can later plug into ocean experiences and regenerative resident life — not a substitute for the RH crown

north_star_energy.feel: Experiment, discovery, prosperity — never factory mode; never alone without a shared-mind tribe
north_star_energy.win_condition_this_season: 3 real regenerative builder/funder/designer conversations + a written deal-path definition (intro → close → distribute)

protocol: 1. Read roadmap.json: capacity, ruthless_criteria, active_revenue_track, themes done_tasks / next_tasks
2. A task is READY if every dependency index appears in some theme's done_tasks
3. Exclude tasks whose description starts with 'Parked:' unless user asks for stretch/future
4. Prefer READY tasks on active_revenue_track (regenerative_coastal → Regenerative-Habitat)
5. Pack ≤2h: one 60m task OR two 30m tasks — never a third task that week
6. Offer PRIMARY (crown track) + optional SPARK (ocean_love_surface) if energy is build/discover/polish
7. If user names a mood (tired / excited / social / codey), filter by lane
8. Reject suggestions that violate capacity or ruthless_criteria (no acceptance, >60m, vague)
9. After they finish, move the task object from next_tasks → done_tasks (or ask the agent to)

lanes.connect: humans — builders, funders, designers, captains later
lanes.prosper: deal path, funding distribution, honest money

example_answer_shape.primary: RH-connect-CN-01 — List 10 regenerative builders/funders/designers (60m, connect, regenerative_coastal)
example_answer_shape.spark: CUR-beaches-BH-04 — Beach slug scrolls detail to top (30m, polish) if you want a tiny craft win instead of a second connect hour
example_answer_shape.why: Crown path is human deal flow; capacity is 2h max — pack 1×60 or 2×30
